rootCause.class: percent-encoding vs raw-literal Unicode key mismatch
rootCause.mechanism: new URL().pathname percent-encodes non-ASCII characters when parsing sitemap <loc> XML; walkHtml()/fileToPath() derive paths from raw filesystem directory names (never percent-encoded); norm() did not reconcile the two representations, so the same real page produced two different Map keys and was claimed twice

production.note: Live production reflects the pre-fix state because this phase did not deploy, per explicit instruction. A deployment is required to make this fix live.

validatorCoverage.explanation: scripts/validate-arch02.mjs's sitemap_duplicate_urls counted occurrences by iterating a Set (mathematically guaranteed 0 duplicates by construction, regardless of actual data); scripts/build-sitemap-index.mjs's own internal dup-check had the identical bug using a Map. Both were non-functional, not merely weak. The percent-encoding/NFC mismatch (root cause) would have evaded even a correctly-counted raw-array check, so both the counting-logic fix and the encoding-normalization fix were independently necessary.
validatorCoverage.falsePositiveRisk: None — decoding/NFC-normalizing before comparison only merges strings representing the same real URL
